# As filed, #3251: "I used  as_6_5, /Zi -enable-16bit-types /Qembed_debug"
/T as_6_5 /E main /Zi -enable-16bit-types /Qembed_debug repro.hlsl

# cmd.txt differs in one way only: `-` spelling instead of `/` for Zi/Qembed_debug/T/E.
# dxc treats the two prefixes identically on Windows, but Compiler Explorer's Linux builds
# see a leading `/` as a path, so MSVC-style flags are not testable there at all
# (SKILL.md step 7). Using `-` keeps one command identical across ground truth, the release
# scan and CE. The equivalence is measured, not assumed: variant-as-filed-*.txt runs the
# literal `/`-spelled form above on the ground-truth build.
#
# The entry point is not stated in the issue; the function is called main, so -E main.
# The debug flags are kept because the reporter used them (and their memcpy carried !dbg),
# even though variant-noflags-*.txt shows they are not load-bearing.
